articles.title_en: The effect of universal free school meals on children’s food hardship
articles.title_cn: 全民免费校餐对儿童食物困难的影响
articles.abstract_en: In the United States, the federal government subsidized universal free school meals (UFSM) nationwide during the COVID-19 pandemic. This policy ended in June 2022. In response, several state governments subsidized extensions of UFSM statewide into the 2022–2023 school year. I leverage variation in state extensions of UFSM to examine the policy’s impact on school meal participation and rates of food insufficiency. Using data from the Household Pulse Survey and a difference-in-differences approach, I find that children in states that did not extend UFSM were 12.6 percentage points less likely (38.3% reduction over the sample mean) to participate in school meal programs and 1.5 percentage points more likely (9.8% increase over the sample mean) to experience food insufficiency relative to those in states that did.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，联邦政府在COVID-19大流行期间在全国范围内补贴了全民免费校餐（UFSM）。该政策于2022年六月结束。作为回应，几个州政府补贴将UFSM延长至2022-2023学年的全州范围。我利用各州延长UFSM的差异来考察该政策对校餐参与率和食物不足率的影响。使用家庭脉搏调查数据和双重差分方法，我发现，与延长UFSM的州相比，未延长UFSM的州的儿童参与校餐计划的可能性低12.6个百分点（相对于样本均值下降38.3%），而经历食物不足的可能性高1.5个百分点（相对于样本均值增加9.8%）。

articles.title_en: How do regional and demographic differences in diets affect the health and environmental impact in China?
articles.title_cn: 中国饮食的地区和人口差异如何影响健康与环境影响？
articles.abstract_en: A higher diet quality has been associated with lower environmental impacts, but not consistently. Considering the cultural diversity of dietary habits and the heterogeneity of socioeconomic development in China, we aimed to evaluate the association between diet quality and environmental impacts across demographic subgroups and regions. This study used dietary consumption data from the China Health Nutrition Survey 2011. Diet quality was measured with the Chinese Healthy Eating Index 2016 (CHEI2016). Diet-related environmental impact (Greenhouse Gas Emissions (GHGE), Total Water Use (TWU), and Land Use (LU)) were estimated using the Chinese Food Life Cycle Assessment Database. Multilevel regression models were used to quantify the association of the CHEI2016 score and the diet-related environmental impacts across heterogeneous population subgroups. A one-standard deviation increase in CHEI2016 score was associated with an increase of 9.7% in GHGE, 9.1% in TWU, and 6.4% in LU. This occurs because increasing the consumption of under-consumed foods (dairy products and fruit), partially offsets the environmental benefits of reduced meat consumption. Demographic subgroups characterized by either higher educated or a higher income exhibited a larger proportion of animal-based foods within their diet, consequently leading to higher diet-related environmental impacts. When expressed per standard deviation increase in CHEI2016, the dietary environmental impacts rose fastest in the Metropolitan area and slowest in the Northeast. Diets with higher CHEI2016 scores are associated with higher diet-related environmental impacts among Chinese adults but this varies per region. The development of sustainable diet strategies needs to account for potential trade-off between the health and environmental goals, and dietary habits of consumers in different regions and subpopulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 较高的饮食质量与较低的环境影响相关，但并非始终一致。考虑到中国饮食文化的多样性和社会经济发展的异质性，我们旨在评估不同人口亚组和地区饮食质量与环境影响之间的关联。本研究使用了中国健康与营养调查2011的膳食消费数据。饮食质量采用中国健康饮食指数2016（CHEI2016）衡量。饮食相关环境影响（温室气体排放（GHGE）、总用水量（TWU）和土地利用（LU））使用中国食品生命周期评估数据库进行估算。采用多水平回归模型量化CHEI2016评分与不同人群亚组饮食相关环境影响之间的关联。CHEI2016评分每增加一个标准差，GHGE增加9.7%，TWU增加9.1%，LU增加6.4%。这是因为增加消费不足的食物（乳制品和水果）的消费，部分抵消了减少肉类消费带来的环境效益。受教育程度较高或收入较高的人口亚组，其饮食中动物性食品比例较大，从而导致较高的饮食相关环境影响。按CHEI2016每增加一个标准差表示时，都市区饮食环境影响上升最快，东北地区最慢。CHEI2016评分较高的饮食与中国成年人较高的饮食相关环境影响相关，但这一关联因地区而异。可持续饮食策略的制定需要考虑健康与环境目标之间的潜在权衡，以及不同地区和亚人群消费者的饮食习惯。

articles.title_en: Trends in the school lunch program: Changes in selection, nutrition & health
articles.title_cn: 学校午餐计划的趋势：选择、营养与健康的变化
articles.abstract_en: There has been significant national attention to the issue of childhood obesity, leading policymakers to reform the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) to include stricter nutritional requirements. We use data on school lunch menus to document improvements in the nutritional quality of school meals between 1991 and 2010. We then evaluate how this change in nutritional content maps into obesity outcomes, using panel data on a nationally representative cohort of children, tracking them from kindergarten entry in fall 2010 through the end of fifth grade in spring 2016. We find little evidence that participation in the school lunch program leads to weight gain, as measured by changes in obesity, overweight, and BMI. These results suggest that improvements in the nutritional content of school lunches have been largely successful in reversing the previously negative relationship between school lunches and childhood obesity.
articles.abstract_cn: 全国范围内对儿童肥胖问题给予了高度关注，促使政策制定者改革国家学校午餐计划（NSLP），纳入更严格的营养要求。我们利用学校午餐菜单数据，记录了1991年至2010年间学校膳食营养质量的改善情况。随后，我们使用一个具有全国代表性的儿童队列的面板数据，从2010年秋季进入幼儿园追踪至2016年春季五年级结束，评估了这一营养内容变化如何映射到肥胖结果上。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明参与学校午餐计划会导致体重增加，以肥胖、超重和BMI的变化来衡量。这些结果表明，学校午餐营养内容的改善在很大程度上成功扭转了学校午餐与儿童肥胖之间先前存在的负相关关系。

articles.title_en: Are dairy farmers willing to pay for improved forage varieties? Experimental evidence from Kenya
articles.title_cn: 奶农是否愿意为改良饲草品种付费？来自肯尼亚的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Though improved forage varieties have the potential to supply high quality feed for livestock and optimize livestock nutrition and production, demand for them in developing countries is low. To inform interventions aiming to increase demand for the improved forages such as pricing, we assessed farmers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for different improved seeds and two types of dried feed in Meru County Kenya. We used a mix of sampling strategies to recruit 356 dairy farmers into the study. We used the Becker-De-Groote Marschak (BDM) mechanism to elicit WTP, and a mixed effects model in the analysis. We find that the WTP for the forage products (except one) was below the market prices, and that the WTP differed significantly between farmers in cooperatives and those that were not. For related varieties, none is significantly superior to other varieties in terms of WTP. We also find that farmers who had prior exposure to the forages, larger farm sizes, mainly practiced zero grazing, and owned the livestock were more likely to bid above the market prices. Our results underscore the need for strategies that can lower the prices of the improved forages such as reducing the costs associated with their production, certification, storage, and transportation. Training farmers especially on the benefits of the improved traits can potentially increase the likelihood of farmers paying premiums for the improved traits, an important ingredient for the commercialization of the improved forage products at scale.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管改良饲草品种有潜力为牲畜提供高质量饲料并优化牲畜营养和生产，但发展中国家对其需求较低。为了为旨在提高改良饲草需求（如定价）的干预措施提供信息，我们评估了肯尼亚梅鲁县农民对不同改良种子和两种干饲料的支付意愿（WTP）。我们采用混合抽样策略招募了356名奶农参与研究。我们使用Becker-De-Groote Marschak（BDM）机制来引出WTP，并在分析中使用混合效应模型。我们发现，除一种产品外，饲草产品的WTP低于市场价格，且合作社内农民与非合作社农民的WTP存在显著差异。对于相关品种，在WTP方面没有哪个品种显著优于其他品种。我们还发现，之前接触过饲草、农场规模较大、主要采用零放牧以及拥有牲畜的农民更有可能出价高于市场价格。我们的结果强调了需要采取能够降低改良饲草价格的策略，例如降低其生产、认证、储存和运输相关的成本。对农民进行培训，特别是关于改良性状益处的培训，可能会增加农民为改良性状支付溢价的概率，这是大规模商业化改良饲草产品的重要因素。

articles.title_en: Looking at gender is not enough—How diversity of farmers’ marginalization relates to varietal trait preferences
articles.title_cn: 仅关注性别是不够的——农民边缘化的多样性如何与品种性状偏好相关
articles.abstract_en: Improved crop varieties help farmers adapt to changing climate and socioeconomic challenges. They are essential for meeting the global food demand, but their adoption remains slow and low. One reason for this unsuccessful adoption is the disregard of trait preferences and marginalized contexts of diverse users by actors in varietal development and delivery. The general wisdom regarding trait preferences includes gender-distinct priorities, in which men focus on high yield and marketability, while women prefer good taste and other cooking attributes. However, although gender is a first step toward nuanced preferences, most analyses restrict themselves to gender-based comparisons (frequently using the sex of heads of households), which homogenizes socioeconomic conditions and preferences within gender. Using intrahousehold preference data, our study reveals that the intersection between gender and other social categories presents compounded marginalization that corresponds to similarities or differences in women’s and men’s trait preferences. Cluster analysis reveals that trait preferences of women and men overlap but differ in the traits’ relative importance. Trait preferences are comparable in low-wealth clusters as they operate in similar marginalized contexts and diverge in high-wealth clusters. Furthermore, logit regression shows that factors of marginalization, gender roles, and agency are associated with increased odds of prioritizing specific traits, such as market and culinary traits. Our results demonstrate how diversity of marginalization and intersectionality matters more than gender dichotomies. We anticipate that our intersectional approach to understanding gendered trait preferences can enhance targeted, demand-led, and inclusive varietal development and delivery in the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 改良作物品种有助于农民适应不断变化的气候和社会经济挑战。它们对于满足全球粮食需求至关重要，但其采用率仍然缓慢且低下。这种采用失败的原因之一是品种开发和推广中的参与者忽视了不同用户的性状偏好和边缘化背景。关于性状偏好的普遍观点包括性别差异优先，其中男性关注高产和适销性，而女性偏好良好口味和其他烹饪属性。然而，尽管性别是迈向细致偏好的第一步，但大多数分析仅限于基于性别的比较（通常使用户主性别），这使性别内部的社会经济条件和偏好同质化。利用户内偏好数据，我们的研究揭示，性别与其他社会类别的交叉呈现复合边缘化，这与女性和男性性状偏好的相似性或差异性相对应。聚类分析显示，女性和男性的性状偏好重叠，但在性状的相对重要性上有所不同。在低财富聚类中，性状偏好具有可比性，因为它们在相似的边缘化背景下运作，而在高财富聚类中则出现分歧。此外，逻辑回归表明，边缘化因素、性别角色和自主权与优先考虑特定性状（如市场和烹饪性状）的几率增加相关。我们的结果表明，边缘化和交叉性的多样性比性别二分法更重要。我们预计，我们理解性别性状偏好的交叉方法可以增强未来有针对性的、需求导向的和包容性的品种开发和推广。

articles.title_en: The organizational challenge of international agricultural research: The fifty-year odyssey of the CGIAR
articles.title_cn: 国际农业研究的组织挑战：CGIAR五十年历程
articles.abstract_en: Over its 50-year history, CGIAR has with increasing frequency revisited the question of how best to organize its research to address growing complexity of agricultural, food, and ecological systems, a multiplying set of development goals, changes in global science, increasing diversity of funding, and evolving capacities of partner organizations. We review this evolution over four periods noting inevitable trade-offs and tensions in a system of autonomous centers and sovereign donors, in developing common research strategies, appropriate lines of management, and aligning resources around agreed priorities. As a result, organizational changes have not met expectations and funding has continued to fragment around short-term payoffs at the expense of producing global public goods over the long term. The paper concludes with suggestions for building on the lessons of organizational reform to improve the collective action performance of funders and centers to drive and sustain needed changes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在其50年的历史中，CGIAR越来越频繁地重新审视如何最好地组织其研究，以应对农业、粮食和生态系统日益增长的复杂性、不断增多的开发目标、全球科学的变化、资金来源的多样性以及合作伙伴组织能力的演变。我们回顾了这四个时期的演变，注意到在自主中心和主权捐助者体系中，在制定共同研究战略、适当的管理路线以及围绕商定优先事项调整资源方面，不可避免的权衡和紧张关系。因此，组织变革未能达到预期，资金继续围绕短期回报而分散，牺牲了长期全球公共产品的生产。本文最后提出了建议，以借鉴组织改革的经验，提高资助者和中心的集体行动绩效，推动和维持所需的变革。

articles.title_en: Recall characteristics and food safety process control
articles.title_cn: 召回特征与食品安全过程控制
articles.abstract_en: The Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) initiated 1,073 recalls of meat and poultry products that could cause severe illness or death over 2000–2019. These recalls led to substantial drops in demand that vary by the characteristics of the recall (Zhou and Liu, 2023) and incentivized firms to invest in food safety (Ollinger and Houser, 2020). Following Zhou and Liu (2023) and Ollinger and Houser (2020), this paper examines differences in food safety process control for establishments with different recall characteristics and contrasts that performance with establishments without recalls. Results show that (1) Salmonella share relative to an establishment’s own mean Salmonella share outperforms Salmonella share alone in estimating the likelihood of a recall, (2) 27 percent rather than 12 percent of establishments would have failed to meet the Salmonella standard if a proposed but not yet mandated more stringent standard had been in effect, and (3) most establishments return to normal operating conditions after a recall, but establishments with multiple recalls struggle to regain control of food safety, suggesting they may benefit from an audit of their food safety systems by FSIS or an auditor.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品安全检验局（FSIS）在2000-2019年间发起了1,073起可能导致严重疾病或死亡的肉类和家禽产品召回。这些召回导致需求大幅下降，下降幅度因召回特征而异（Zhou和Liu，2023），并激励企业投资于食品安全（Ollinger和Houser，2020）。遵循Zhou和Liu（2023）以及Ollinger和Houser（2020）的研究，本文考察了具有不同召回特征的机构在食品安全过程控制上的差异，并将其表现与无召回机构进行对比。结果表明：（1）相对于机构自身平均沙门氏菌比例的沙门氏菌比例，在估计召回可能性方面优于单独的沙门氏菌比例；（2）如果一项拟议但尚未强制实施的更严格标准生效，27%而非12%的机构将无法达到沙门氏菌标准；（3）大多数机构在召回后恢复正常运营条件，但多次召回的机构难以重新控制食品安全，这表明它们可能受益于FSIS或审计员对其食品安全体系的审计。

articles.title_en: Assessing the inhibitory effect and intervention mechanism of food traceability system on reducing hog farmers’ overuse of animal antibiotics in China
articles.title_cn: 评估食品可追溯系统对减少中国养猪户动物抗生素过度使用的抑制作用及干预机制
articles.abstract_en: The use of animal antibiotics is a double-edged sword. It can be used for disease treatment, health protection, and growth promoters. It also creates antibiotic residues and resistance, poses risks, and damages food safety, ecosystems, and public health. Under the pressure of disease risk and expected losses, farmers' overuse of animal antibiotics exacerbates this dual objective incompatibility. In this study, we employ the endogenous switching regression (ESR) model and the mediating effect method to empirically analyze the inhibitory effect and intervention mechanism of the food traceability system (FTS) on reducing farmers’ overuse of antibiotics by using the survey data of hog farmers from China. This paper measures the “dose” unit of antibiotics farmers use regarding cost and the active ingredients of antibiotics per kilogram of treated infected hogs. The study finds evidence that the FTS exerts a significant inhibitory effect on the overuse of antibiotics by farmers. The counterfactual hypothesis unveils that non-participation in the FTS by the involved farmers will increase the cost of antibiotics overuse by 0.080 yuan/kg, while if the farmers currently not participating are to engage with the FTS, the price will decrease by 0.126 yuan/kg. This effect persists across control variables controlled in turn and the unit doses of active ingredients of tetracycline, sulfonamides, β-lactam, chloramphenicol, and macrolide antibiotics. Moreover, our results reveal thatthe inhibitory effects of the FTS on over-the-counter and broad-spectrum antibiotics are more significant than on prescription and narrow-spectrum antibiotics. The results show that the inhibition effect of the FTS on the overuse of antibiotics by free-range, professional, and large-scale farmers exhibits an approximately inverse-U curvilinear relationship. Besides, the intervention mechanism of the FTS on the overuse of antibiotics by farmers mainly consists of social reputation maintenance, liability traceability for antibiotic residues, and biosafety enhancement, and the proportion of their mediating effects in the total impact are 24.22%, 21.84%, and 10.87%, respectively. Our empirical study has yielded several implications, such as strengthening the FTS construction, improving farmers’ antibiotic use skills, promoting standardized breeding levels, and increasing the market premium for food products that adhere to antibiotic residue standards. These outcomes not only contribute to the improvement of livestock production safety but also reduce the problem of antibiotic overuse.
articles.abstract_cn: 动物抗生素的使用是一把双刃剑。它可用于疾病治疗、健康保护和促生长剂。它也会产生抗生素残留和耐药性，带来风险，并损害食品安全、生态系统和公共健康。在疾病风险和预期损失的压力下，农户对抗生素的过度使用加剧了这种双重目标的不相容性。在本研究中，我们采用内生转换回归（ESR）模型和中介效应方法，利用中国养猪户的调查数据，实证分析食品可追溯系统（FTS）对减少农户抗生素过度使用的抑制作用及干预机制。本文以成本和每公斤受感染猪只的抗生素有效成分来衡量农户使用的抗生素“剂量”单位。研究发现，FTS对农户抗生素过度使用具有显著的抑制作用。反事实假设揭示，参与农户若不参与FTS，抗生素过度使用成本将增加0.080元/公斤，而当前未参与农户若参与FTS，价格将下降0.126元/公斤。这一效应在依次控制控制变量以及四环素、磺胺类、β-内酰胺类、氯霉素和大环内酯类抗生素有效成分的单位剂量后依然存在。此外，我们的结果显示，FTS对非处方和广谱抗生素的抑制作用比对处方和窄谱抗生素更为显著。结果表明，FTS对散养、专业和规模化农户抗生素过度使用的抑制效应呈近似倒U型曲线关系。此外，FTS对农户抗生素过度使用的干预机制主要包括社会声誉维护、抗生素残留责任追溯和生物安全提升，其中介效应在总影响中的比例分别为24.22%、21.84%和10.87%。我们的实证研究得出了一些启示，如加强FTS建设、提高农户抗生素使用技能、促进标准化养殖水平，以及提高符合抗生素残留标准的食品的市场溢价。这些成果不仅有助于提高畜牧生产安全，还能减少抗生素过度使用问题。

articles.title_en: Putting your money where your mouth is: Accelerating investment action for healthy and sustainable food systems in Australia
articles.title_cn: 言行一致：加速澳大利亚健康可持续食品系统的投资行动
articles.abstract_en: Institutional investors have considerable potential to positively contribute to shifts towards healthier, more sustainable food systems. However, food systems issues are not systematically taken into account by investors as part of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations. This study aimed to identify current approaches to investment decision making regarding food systems issues and ways to facilitate increased consideration of food systems issues as part of investment decision-making in Australia.
articles.abstract_cn: 机构投资者在推动向更健康、更可持续的食品系统转变方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，食品系统问题并未被投资者系统性地纳入环境、社会和治理（ESG）考量之中。本研究旨在识别当前关于食品系统问题的投资决策方法，并探索在澳大利亚促进投资决策中更多考虑食品系统问题的途径。

articles.title_en: Does organic farming jeopardize food security of farm households in Benin?
articles.title_cn: 有机农业是否危及贝宁农户的粮食安全？
articles.abstract_en: The prevalence of organic farming and other sustainability standards is increasing around the globe. While effects of organic farming on productivity, income, and poverty alleviation have been analyzed in numerous empirical studies, its effects on food security are barely understood. Using data from smallholder cotton farmers in Benin, we aim to empirically investigate how adopting organic farming affects their food security. According to our results, organic farming is conditionally associated with a notably lower experienced food security and a slightly lower dietary diversity and consumption of vitamin A-rich foods. Evaluating pathways, we find that the negative conditional association between organic farming and food security is a result of a lower household income of organic farms due to lower income from cotton farming given a smaller land area cultivated with cotton, while a larger land area cultivated with food crops cannot fully compensate for the reduced income from cotton farming. This alarming result illustrates the need for evaluating and eventually improving programs for organic farming in developing countries to ensure that good intentions for more sustainable production practices do not jeopardize the livelihoods of vulnerable smallholder farmers.
articles.abstract_cn: 有机农业和其他可持续性标准的普及在全球范围内日益增加。虽然许多实证研究分析了有机农业对生产力、收入和减贫的影响，但其对粮食安全的影响却鲜有了解。利用贝宁小农棉农的数据，我们旨在实证研究采用有机农业如何影响其粮食安全。根据我们的结果，有机农业与显著较低的经历性粮食安全以及略低的饮食多样性和维生素A丰富食物的消费呈条件性相关。通过评估路径，我们发现有机农业与粮食安全之间的负向条件关联是由于有机农场的家庭收入较低，这源于棉花种植收入较低，因为棉花种植面积较小，而粮食作物种植面积较大无法完全弥补棉花种植收入的减少。这一令人震惊的结果表明，有必要评估并最终改进发展中国家的有机农业项目，以确保对更可持续生产实践的良好意图不会危及脆弱小农的生计。

articles.title_en: Government fertilizer subsidies, input use, and income: The case of Senegal
articles.title_cn: 政府化肥补贴、投入品使用与收入：塞内加尔案例
articles.abstract_en: Most Sub-Saharan countries implement input subsidy programs (ISPs) in an attempt to increase fertilizer use, crop yields and farmers’ income and to improve household food security. Senegal is no exception and has had an ISP in place for the last 15 years. This article assesses how access to subsidized fertilizer under the ISP is associated with changes in fertilizer and manure use and gross margin. Using household-level data from two agroecological zones, we employ an endogenous switching regression framework to control for the potential endogeneity of access to subsidized fertilizer. We find that access to subsidized fertilizer is associated with an increase in the total use of fertilizer of +39 % but also with a reduction in the use of commercial fertilizer of 18 %. Access to subsidized fertilizer is also associated with a reduction in the likelihood of using manure of 5 % and an increase in farmers’ total gross margin of 11 %. Results are heterogeneous across agroecological zones, with a strong crowding-out of commercial fertilizer where widely available to farmers. In this case, revising the design of the ISP could lead to improved efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数撒哈拉以南非洲国家实施投入品补贴计划（ISPs），以期提高化肥使用量、作物产量和农民收入，并改善家庭粮食安全。塞内加尔也不例外，在过去15年中一直实施ISP。本文评估了在ISP下获得补贴化肥的机会与化肥和粪肥使用量及毛利润变化的关系。利用来自两个农业生态区的农户层面数据，我们采用内生转换回归框架来控制获得补贴化肥的潜在内生性。我们发现，获得补贴化肥与化肥总使用量增加39%相关，但也与商业化肥使用量减少18%相关。获得补贴化肥还与使用粪肥的可能性降低5%以及农民总毛利润增加11%相关。结果在不同农业生态区之间存在异质性，在商业化肥广泛可得的地区，存在强烈的挤出效应。在这种情况下，修订ISP的设计可能有助于提高效率。

articles.title_en: A trade-off between lives and the economy? Subsidizing dining out under the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan
articles.title_cn: 生命与经济之间的权衡？日本COVID-19疫情期间外出就餐补贴
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how a government subsidy for dining out to support the restaurant industry has been associated with economic and health outcomes during the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan. Using nationwide 500-meter mesh data, we demonstrate that Japan’s Go To Eat scheme, which was gradually introduced across all prefectures beginning in October 2020, mitigated the negative impact of the pandemic on population mobility in restaurant areas, while having little association with the spread of COVID-19 afterward. The influence was particularly large for population mobility within a prefecture and in restaurant areas near train stations. The scheme also had diminishing positive spillover effects around the restaurant areas. The findings imply that such a subsidy can be a balanced policy response to the pandemic once epidemiological factors are properly managed.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在COVID-19疫情期间，日本政府为支持餐饮业而提供的外出就餐补贴如何与经济及健康结果相关联。利用全国500米网格数据，我们证明日本的“Go To Eat”计划（于2020年十月起逐步在所有都道府县实施）缓解了疫情对餐饮区域人口流动性的负面影响，同时对后续COVID-19的传播几乎没有关联。该影响在都道府县内及火车站附近的餐饮区域尤为显著。该计划在餐饮区域周围还具有递减的正向溢出效应。研究结果表明，在流行病学因素得到妥善管理的情况下，此类补贴可以成为应对疫情的平衡政策选择。

articles.title_en: The impacts of widespread agricultural interventions on yields and food security in Ethiopia☆
articles.title_cn: 广泛农业干预对埃塞俄比亚产量和粮食安全的影响☆
authors: Ana Paula de la O Campos
articles.abstract_en: In the past decades, the Government of Ethiopia implemented widespread interventions with the objective of modernizing the agricultural sector and stimulating transformative growth. This paper assesses the agricultural yields and food security impacts of those interventions. Combining project and remote-sensing data with a nationally representative household panel survey, we identify impacts by exploiting the temporal and geographic variation in the roll-out of the interventions implemented by the Ethiopian Agricultural Transformation Agency from 2011 to 2016. Results show that large-scale agricultural interventions are associated with higher agricultural yields and better food security outcomes. These outcomes underscore the linkages that persist between agricultural development and food security for rural households living in mostly agrarian economies and the potential for systems-wide interventions to catalyze agricultural transformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，埃塞俄比亚政府实施了广泛的干预措施，旨在实现农业部门现代化并刺激转型增长。本文评估了这些干预措施对农业产量和粮食安全的影响。结合项目数据、遥感数据以及具有全国代表性的住户面板调查，我们利用埃塞俄比亚农业转型局从2011年到2016年实施的干预措施在时间和地理上的推广差异来识别影响。结果表明，大规模农业干预与更高的农业产量和更好的粮食安全结果相关。这些结果强调了在主要以农业经济为主的农村家庭中，农业发展与其粮食安全之间持续存在的联系，以及全系统干预措施催化农业转型的潜力。
